dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped annuli exhibit irregular, jagged outer perimeters characterized by a sharp transition from dark dorsal pigmentation to high-intensity, stippled light-grey interiors. The geometry of the perimeters is non-uniform, consisting of micro-clusters of high-intensity pixels.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, asymmetrical high-intensity pixel clusters localized primarily along the upper-most curve of the dorsal ridge, where light exposure is maximal; these clusters lack internal gradients and appear as saturated white points.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the four most prominent dorsal-lateral macro-annuli form an elongated, irregular quadrilateral configuration. The angular relationship between the two most anterior centroids and the adjacent lateral centroid forms an obtuse angle of approximately 130 degrees.
